title: A shared machine names one owning repo, and every other repo checks its health and holds first
why: Your HA Green problem, Oct 27 13:15 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2RSWZr4XsNtpstx8kVFBn66): home, degen, home-app and later mailaudit all load one 4 GB box that crashed 3 times, no repo owns its load budget, and degen's deploy script lives in home behind a guard, so fixes deadlock across repos.
note: Proposal (coordinator): a shared-resource convention. Each shared machine names one owning repo (the HA Green: home-app, which holds home since Oct 26). The owner keeps (a) a box-health preflight script (swap, disk errors, open holds) and (b) a hold record. Ruling, Oct 27 13:22 CDT (shiv, cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2FS8R88VGL2A75ER5mnDyai, "it shd go to degen"): each user repo owns its own deploy and restart scripts; the owner owns only the shared check and the hold record, and a change to those goes to the owner as a hand-off, never an override. Every user repo's session runs the preflight before a deploy, a restart or a bulk import, and reads the holds. Part 1, ready, claude-settings only. Next cloud lane: the convention in docs/ (one home), a lint that a repo declaring a shared resource in .claude/layout-extras.json cites its owner and the preflight path, and the hand-off pattern in skill project-ops; red first on a declaration with no owner. Part 2, the roll-out to other repos, is c141. Needs no answer. Port: yes; part 2 carries it. Placed ahead of c107 (triage, Oct 27): three crashes in eight days. Part 1 green and reviewed: draft PR #743 (head 851f61ad, main 4e913588 merged in, the notes.md conflict kept both sides; local gates and silent-undo clean), round 2 approved; decision shared-resource-owner holds the convention, and lint/check_shared_resources.py checks a repo's shared-resources entry in .claude/layout-extras.json. Batch 5 (a docs/debts/notes.md conflict kept it out of batch 4).
